messages:
jess: Quick q — are we planning to cut release/1.16 today? I have a doc-only PR that should land before cutoff.

tyler: Cutoff is 16:00 UTC. We still need the branch created and a snapshot. Docs-only ok if merged before cutoff. No breaking changes after cutoff :no_entry_sign:.

jess: Thanks — does docs-only require backport to 1.15? It's just a changelog tweak.

samir: If it's purely docs and doesn't touch runtime code, skip backport unless the patch branch is actively maintained. Tag with `docs` and `backport-not-needed`.

maria: Note: if anyone touches API surface or default behavior we treat it as a semver/minor decision. Also please add a one-line entry under CHANGELOG/next.md with the repo/area.

alex: I can create the release/1.16 branch and push the version bump. Will also seed the changelog. Plan: 
```
git checkout -b release/1.16
# bump VERSION file to 1.16.0
git commit -am "release: prepare 1.16.0"
git push origin release/1.16
```

release-bot: :gear: release/1.16 branch created by alex. PR template checklist attached. Reminder: run `make snapshot` to capture build artifacts.

tyler: Backport policy reminder — only regressions, security fixes, and critical bug fixes get backported. For anything else, add `backport-request` label with justification and we'll triage during post-cut.

jess: Great — alex, can you add the changelog line now? I'll merge the doc PR before 15:30 UTC to make cutoff. :eyes: 

alex: Will do, posting branch link when pushed :rocket:

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-server/compare/release/1.16
